hyperedges.label: Fixed boss order: Nørdic (3:00), Printer (6:00), Fristen (9:00), Johan (12:00+)
Performance measures for office PCs without GPU
Determinism via seeded separate RNG streams (Dagens vakt)

nodes.label: Bosses (fixed order, mandatory)
nodes.rationale: Bosses at 3:00, 6:00, 9:00, 12:00 then Johan every 3 min. All attacks are telegraphed (0.65 s). While a boss is out, 55% fewer regular lawyers; a distant boss jogs to catch up. Names/lines/numbers in CONFIG.bosses; appearance in js/figures.js.

nodes.label: Johan (final boss, 12:00, returns every 3 min)
nodes.rationale: Reference photo used only as a model, not included in the project.

nodes.label: Nørdic-konsulenten (boss 1, 3:00)
nodes.rationale: Nørdic is a fictional company with its own logo (braces around an N) in forest green and lime, to avoid using any real brand.

nodes.label: Johan (final boss)
nodes.rationale: Drawn in the same style as playable characters at double size. Attacks: sprint (line telegraph, x1.6 damage), five calendar invites, «Alle på møte!» ring of junior associates (once per 30 s within the 400 cap), and earlier bosses' attacks from half frustration. Phase two: takes off the jacket, faster, attacks more often. Returns every 3 minutes.

nodes.label: Leaderboard plausibility limits
nodes.rationale: Max 5000 points and 50 helped per second before a run is considered unrealistic; v4 added the fired column (auto-migrated) and aligned checks with the new boss order.

nodes.label: Multifunksjonsmonsteret (boss 2)
nodes.rationale: CMYK cartridges become ink puddles (30% slow, 4 s, max 8), 400-page print job sweep, paper jam every ~15 s (stuck 3 s, takes double help).

nodes.label: Nørdic-konsulenten (boss 1)
nodes.rationale: Fictional company to avoid any real name/logo/colour/typeface. Attacks: hold-music ring (40% slow, 2 s, no damage), ticket splitting into three, «Vi ringer deg tilbake» (uncatchable 3 s, max once per 20 s).

nodes.label: Stress test results v4 (3.5-3.8 ms/frame)
nodes.rationale: Stepped with fixed tick because the preview panel throttles requestAnimationFrame. 400 lawyers, Johan out, four combos, utenGPU: 99% of frames under 12 ms, memory flat 4.5-5.8 MB.

nodes.label: Version 4.0 (endringsprompt 3): four bosses, chain keys, homing alerts, Skytsengelen
nodes.norm_label: version 4.0 (endringsprompt 3): four bosses, chain keys, homing alerts, skytsengelen

nodes.label: «Du har fått sparken!» (fired on boss timeout)
nodes.norm_label: «du har fatt sparken!» (fired on boss timeout)
nodes.rationale: Bosses are mandatory: if the countdown runs out the game freezes, the boss looks disappointed, and the run ends as fired. Score can still be submitted; leaderboard shows a moving box icon.

nodes.label: Mandatory bosses and «Du har fått sparken!»
nodes.norm_label: mandatory bosses and «du har fatt sparken!»
nodes.rationale: Boss table with countdown, frustration and points (Nørdic 120 s/850/2500; printer 120 s/2200/4000; Fristen 120 s/4400/6000; Johan 150 s/6500/15000, x1.5 and x1.4 per return). Countdown expiry freezes the game and fires the player; score still submittable; big top clock turns yellow at 30 s and red/blinking at 10 s respecting reduced-flash setting.

nodes.label: Office map (2560x1440, zones, decor, doors)
nodes.rationale: Zones in SONER, decor in lagPynt(), doors/elevators in DOERER, glass walls in GLASS (js/map.js); size and wall thickness in CONFIG.map. Decor never blocks movement, only outer walls do.

nodes.label: tools/simulate.js (bot balance simulator)
nodes.rationale: Bots play full rounds in seconds; reports survival time, bosses helped, fired. Also checks determinism (two equal rounds give identical results, including Dobbel skjerm) and that lawyer appearance never affects gameplay. --statistikk runs 10 days x 4 characters.

nodes.label: Bounded office map and minimap (v2)
nodes.rationale: Replaced the old 'move closer' mechanism: lawyers spawn off-screen (380-560 px), from elevators/doors when crowded, never closer than 260 px. Minimap updated 10 times per second.

nodes.label: js/config.js (all balance numbers)
nodes.rationale: Single place for every tunable number with a comment per field: spawn.rate, scaling.*, level, weapons.<id>.levels, combination.stats, enemies.urgent, bosses, energyDrink, limits.weapons, characters, sender, enemyShots.

nodes.label: Version 3.1: code translated to English
nodes.rationale: Identifiers, files, API (/api/leaderboard), DB table (entries) renamed to English; in-game text stays Norwegian; behaviour byte-identical (simulator and font verified). localStorage keys (hds_...), debug URLs and Norwegian docs deliberately not translated.

nodes.label: Dagens vakt (seeded daily randomness)
nodes.rationale: All randomness comes from a seeded mulberry32 generator keyed by today's date in Norwegian time, split into separate streams (spawn timing, spawn position, urgent/boss, upgrade cards, Ny PC drops, energy drink placement, Fjernstyring, Dobbel skjerm, appearance). Math.random() is never used, so everyone plays the same round.

nodes.label: Boss balance adjustments (v4)
nodes.rationale: Bosses initially cut good bots' median from 12 to 7 minutes, mostly because bots had to walk into the crowd and got slowed rather than from damage. Fix: 55% fewer regular lawyers during a boss (CONFIG.bosses.spawnFactor), distant boss jogs to catch up (catchUpFrom/catchUpSpeed), lower boss damage and frustration. Result: median 10.5/9.0 min, 3 and 2 of 40 fired.

nodes.label: #debug panel (overlay and debug buttons)
nodes.rationale: Buttons data-d: t60, t180, level, level10, max, combo, immortal, boss, urgent, pc, drink, swarm, boss1-boss4, stress.

nodes.label: #gameOver screen (portrait, fired line, bosses, stats, submit form)
nodes.norm_label: #gameover screen (portrait, fired line, bosses, stats, submit form)

nodes.label: index.html (page and menus)
nodes.rationale: lang=nb, preloads fonts/kontorpiksel.ttf, links css/style.css, loads js/main.js as ES module; inline SVG data-URI favicon; noscript fallback.

nodes.label: Four playable characters
nodes.rationale: Odyssefs, Johannes, Jin, Julian (IT-avdelingen), each with starting weapon and bonus in CONFIG.characters; appearance in js/figures.js (PLAYERS, drawPortrait). Reference photos are not in the project.

nodes.label: Debug mode (?debug overlay and buttons)
nodes.rationale: Performance overlay (FPS, ms per frame split update/draw, entity counts, memory, quality level, help/s per weapon). Rounds using debug buttons cannot be submitted to the leaderboard.

nodes.label: Stress test (5 min, 400 lawyers, utenGPU)
nodes.rationale: &utenGPU forces all drawing onto the CPU, the worst case matching office PCs without GPU support.

nodes.label: KontorPiksel pixel font
nodes.rationale: Self-made with æ, ø, å; glyphs in js/pixelfont.js; TTF rebuilt with tools/build-font.js; CC0.

nodes.label: Four bosses in fixed order, mandatory
nodes.norm_label: four bosses in fixed order, mandatory

nodes.label: Help Desk Survivors (game overview)
nodes.rationale: Internal competition game for Help Forsikring; static files only (HTML/CSS/ES modules), no build step, no npm packages, no external assets, ~0.3 MB.

nodes.label: KontorPiksel font license notice
nodes.rationale: Self-made for the project; glyphs in js/pixelfont.js, file generated by tools/build-font.js. Charset A-Z, a-z, ÆØÅ, É, ÄÖÜ, digits and common symbols.

nodes.label: Help Desk Survivors (README overview)
nodes.rationale: Survivors-style (Vampire Survivors-like) office browser game; weapons fire automatically; all in-game text in Norwegian bokmål.

nodes.label: KontorPiksel own pixel font (CC0)
nodes.rationale: A self-made CC0 font was created instead of fetching an OFL font because nothing may be loaded from the internet. Used both as TTF in menus and drawn directly on the canvas.

nodes.label: Plain JavaScript, no build step
nodes.rationale: HTML5 Canvas 2D and ES modules; no npm packages, external scripts, images or sound files; sprites, font and sound generated in code (~0.4 MB).

nodes.label: «Haster!»-avsenderen (ranged email lawyer)
nodes.rationale: Appears from 2:30, keeps 150-200 px away, telegraphs each shot 0.5 s. Caps: 15% of lawyers, 30 at once, 60 enemy projectiles total. Numbers in CONFIG.sender and CONFIG.enemyShots.

nodes.label: Four playable characters (v3)
nodes.rationale: 32x32 sprites and 64x64 portraits drawn after four reference photos that are not in the project. Weak starting weapons (Toner-kast, HDMI-kabelen, Trådløse mus) buffed at levels 1-2 so three of four characters were not clearly weaker than character 1.

nodes.label: «Fristen er om 2 minutter!» (boss 3)
nodes.rationale: Fan of three emails; line «Kan du se på dette før lunsj?» chosen as placeholder because the prompt gave none.

nodes.label: «Haster!»-avsenderen (v3 ranged lawyer)
nodes.rationale: Keeps 150-200 px distance, emails every ~3 s at 57 px/s (60% of player speed), only shoots when on screen so the warning is always visible. Caps 15% / 30 / 60 emails.

nodes.label: Version 3.0 (endringsprompt 2): difficulty, characters, sender, new weapons
nodes.norm_label: version 3.0 (endringsprompt 2): difficulty, characters, sender, new weapons

nodes.label: Combination nerf v3 (87-113% of mean)
nodes.rationale: Measured with tools/maalvaapen.js (150 lawyers around a moving player). Strongest combos nerfed most (Kontorprinteren -82%, Full omstart -70%) so none is an obvious pick; changes are less help, smaller area, longer cooldown.

nodes.label: Difficulty curve v3 (slower levelling, overtime from 13:00)
nodes.norm_label: difficulty curve v3 (slower levelling, overtime from 13:00)
nodes.rationale: XP per level 20 + 13n + 1.5n^2. Frustration only +8%/min (not +18%) before overtime because combinations were weakened 31-82%, levelling is slower and senders are new; with +18% even expert bots died in 3-5 min. The ~15 min wall comes from overtime: x1.6 per minute on frustration/damage and +15% speed per minute from 13:00, so lawyers outrun the player after ~16-17 min.

nodes.label: Skytsengelen (guardian angel weapon)
nodes.rationale: Throws mini-printers; fixed cap of simultaneous mini-printers (2, 4, 6; 10 as combination Himmelsk serviceavtale) identical for all players to keep determinism and performance.

nodes.label: Weapons, passives and combinations
nodes.rationale: 11 weapons (max 4), 12 passives (max 6). Weapon at level 8 plus the right passive yields a combination. Numbers in CONFIG.weapons and CONFIG.newWeapons.

nodes.label: Passord-reset as chain weapon / Tofaktor
nodes.rationale: Key hops lawyer to lawyer within 80 px, 0.07 s per hop, each lawyer hit at most once per chain; 3 hops at level 1, 10 at level 8. Tofaktor: two chains in opposite directions, 16 hops each.

nodes.label: Skytsengelen (new weapon) / Himmelsk serviceavtale
nodes.rationale: Hovering untouchable angel throws mini-printers at the nearest lawyer; printers walk, shoot paper, vanish in a paper cloud. Fixed cap 2/4/6 (10 as combination). Brings weapon count to 11.

nodes.label: Teams-varsel homing alerts / Allmøte på Teams
nodes.norm_label: teams-varsel homing alerts / allmøte pa teams
nodes.rationale: v4 changed Teams-varsel from bouncing to homing (1-5 alerts); Allmøte splits each alert into three on hit.

nodes.label: Daily leaderboard (toppliste)
nodes.rationale: Stored in server/data/leaderboard.db (SQLite, movable with DATA_DIR); not to be placed in OneDrive/SharePoint-synced folders because sync can lock the file. Resets at midnight Norwegian time, one entry per name, server rejects unrealistic scores and rate-limits submissions.

nodes.label: Deployment (single server or static hosting)
nodes.rationale: Only index.html, css/, js/, fonts/ served publicly. Behind a reverse proxy forward / and /api/. Static hosting works but leaderboard shows unavailable until /api/leaderboard and /api/score respond; swap storage by replacing fetchLeaderboard(date) and submitScore(entry) in js/leaderboard.js.

nodes.label: Leaderboard API (GET /api/leaderboard, POST /api/score)
nodes.rationale: GET ?date&name returns { date, top (20), own, count }; POST { name, date, character, score, time, helped, maxMult, fired } returns { ok, improved, spot }.

nodes.label: Requirements: Node.js 22.5+ with node:sqlite
nodes.rationale: Built-in node:sqlite means no npm install.

nodes.label: Quick start (npm start / start.ps1)
nodes.rationale: Must be served over http(s) since browsers block ES modules on file://. start.ps1 uses the Node runtime bundled with VS Code. Env vars PORT (3000) and DATA_DIR (server/data).

nodes.label: Code-drawn pixel graphics (palette-indexed grids)
nodes.rationale: All graphics drawn in code via js/pixel.js; lawyers composed from layers (skin 7, age, body, hairstyle 10, hair colour 6, glasses, beard, earrings, tie/scarf, skirt/trousers) with appearance drawn from its own RNG stream so it never affects gameplay.

nodes.label: Settings menu (Innstillinger)
nodes.rationale: Sound muted by default because it is an office. Stored locally, applies immediately. Every screen sees exactly 640x360 of map regardless of game size.

nodes.label: Visibly happy lawyers (thumbs-up animation)
nodes.rationale: When frustration hits zero the lawyer stops, cannot hurt or be hit, drops the ticket; 0.5 s animation, drawn under active lawyers; shortened to 0.25 s when over 60 happy at once.

nodes.label: Bigger HUD (energy-drink bar, 48px icons)
nodes.rationale: HUD drawn on its own full-resolution canvas only when something changed (max ~20 times/s).

nodes.label: Procedurally composed diverse lawyers
nodes.rationale: 42 variants for common types, 21 for urgent, 12 for boss, all traits evenly distributed; appearance uses its own RNG stream so it never affects Dagens vakt (simulator confirms).

nodes.label: Four new weapons/passives/combinations (v3)
nodes.rationale: Ctrl+Z+Hurtigtaster=Ctrl+Alt+Del; Oppdateringsstrålen+Sertifisering=Tvungen oppdatering; Teams-varsel+Dobbel skjerm=Allmøte på Teams; Støydempende headset+Ergonomisk stol=Hjemmekontor. Passives: Dobbel skjerm (+5% double activation, own RNG stream, burst weapons only), Hurtigtaster (+12% projectile speed), Ergonomisk stol (-6% damage), Sertifisering (+8% XP).

nodes.label: Pixel art style at 640x360 (v2)
nodes.rationale: Internal 640x360 canvas scaled with nearest-neighbour (image-rendering: pixelated), integer scale where possible. All sprites are palette-indexed pixel grids in code; 4-frame walk cycle mirrored for left/right.

nodes.label: Settings menu (v2)
nodes.rationale: Mute, master volume, effects (test sound on release), fullscreen, game size, UI size, minimap, screen shake, reduced flashing, reset to defaults. Saved locally with try/catch; sound still off by default (50% when enabled).

nodes.label: Version 2.0 (endringsprompt 1): pixel art, map, HUD, performance
nodes.norm_label: version 2.0 (endringsprompt 1): pixel art, map, hud, performance

nodes.label: Dobbel skjerm (passive with own RNG stream)
nodes.norm_label: dobbel skjerm (passive with own rng stream)
nodes.rationale: Uses its own randomness stream so the same choices give the same round for everyone.

nodes.label: Automatic quality level
nodes.rationale: If frame time exceeds 16.5 ms for 1.5 s, glitter, speech bubbles, happy animation and effect fills are reduced in two steps, restored after 8 s of good frames. Lives only in render code so it can never affect game logic (determinism).

nodes.label: Energy drink must be fetched (v2)
nodes.rationale: No longer drops from lawyers; first at 0:30 then every 35 s, max 3, at least 960 px away. Placement uses its own RNG stream ('drikk') because the drop stream is consumed per helped lawyer and would give different places to different players.

nodes.label: Object pools and swap-and-pop
nodes.rationale: No filter/map/new objects per frame in the game loop; max 60 projectiles per weapon and 900 effects; projectiles removed when off-screen.

nodes.label: Performance overhaul v2 (causes of v1 stutter)
nodes.norm_label: performance overhaul v2 (causes of v1 stutter)
nodes.rationale: v1 stutter causes: downscaled 3x sprites transformed each frame (~0.47 ms per figure without GPU, >200 ms per frame at 300 lawyers), full-screen canvas fills, GC churn from per-frame colour strings, up to 5 logic updates per frame. Fixes: 640x360 world canvas, 1:1 sprite copies, pre-rendered map canvas, cached effect sprites (no shadowBlur/gradients), fixed timestep max 4 updates, max 400 active lawyers (extra ones 'saved' and buff the next), sound buffers reused. Stress test: 2.86 ms avg, 0 frames over 16.7 ms.

nodes.label: Separate RNG streams for determinism
nodes.rationale: Spawn positions depend on where the player stands, so they come from their own stream ('plass'); timing and types still come from the spawn stream so they are identical for everyone. Energy drink uses the 'drikk' stream.

nodes.label: Spatial grid (32 px cells) for collisions
nodes.norm_label: spatial grid (32 px cells) for collisions
nodes.rationale: All collisions use a 32 px grid; lawyer-to-lawyer pushing checks at most 6 neighbours.

nodes.label: One sprite atlas per figure type
nodes.norm_label: one sprite atlas per figure type
nodes.rationale: Drawing from many small canvases measured ~20x slower (0.09 vs 0.004 ms per figure). Atlases are built during the start screen and never changed in-game because modifying an atlas mid-game caused 150-600 ms spikes from re-uploading the whole atlas.
